text.cn: 酒吧燈開始閃。有人遞菜單，有人遞『騎行團』傳單，有人只是想跟你合照。
text.en: Bar lights blink. Menus appear, bike-tour flyers appear, and someone just wants a photo with you.

text.cn: 來一杯，聽聽西街租金傳說。
text.en: Have a drink; listen to West Street rent myths.

text.cn: 拒絕續攤，早點回旅館充電。
text.en: Skip the crawl; charge at the hotel early.

text.cn: 💰 西街合照收費（外國面孔溢價區）。
text.en: 💰 Charge for West Street photos (foreign-face premium zone).

lockedHint.cn: 精神面貌太差（Sanity < 70），没人想付钱找你。
lockedHint.en: You look too drained (Sanity < 70). Nobody wants to pay you.

text.cn: 西街日結束。燈還亮著，你的社交電量不一定。
text.en: West Street day ends. Lights still on; your social battery maybe not.
